title: Account Onboarding
summary: Help a newly registered person complete necessary profile setup and optional preferences, with a clear distinction between account creation and readiness to continue.

title: Account Recovery
summary: Help people regain access through an authorized password-reset process with clear request, reset, failure, and completion boundaries.

title: Application Submission
summary: Help people prepare, correct, and submit an application once, retain recoverable work, and distinguish a confirmed receipt from an approval decision.

title: Authentication
summary: Provide a bounded task for establishing or renewing access while preserving the intended destination and any safely recoverable work.

title: Checkout
summary: Help people review an order and its complete monetary commitment, submit payment once, and understand the confirmed payment and fulfillment outcome.

title: Comparison
summary: Help visitors compare plans or service offers on a consistent basis, understand qualifications, and choose an eligible next step.

title: Initial Setup
summary: Help an authorized person configure and provision a new resource, understand which operations completed, and recover unfinished work without duplicate creation.

title: Product Landing
summary: Help visitors understand a product or service, assess relevant evidence, and choose a clearly described next action.

title: Public Content
summary: Help visitors read, understand, and navigate a durable public information resource with clear identity, hierarchy, provenance, and related destinations.

title: Public Status Overview
summary: Help visitors understand the reported availability of named public services, affected scope, freshness, and published incident or maintenance information.

title: Record Collection
summary: Help people find, compare, select, and act on a collection of records while preserving their query and their place when inspecting an individual record.

title: Record Detail
summary: Help people understand one record, its current state and history, and the actions they can take while retaining a meaningful path back to related work.

title: Registration
summary: Collect only the information needed to create an account, explain material requirements before commitment, and identify whether the account is active or still awaiting verification.

title: Settings
summary: Help people review and change persistent preferences or configuration with clear save boundaries, understandable consequences, and protection for unsaved work.
